items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: I phoned him before this interview and I said, “Why did you pick Ed for that album you did about the wasp?”

ctx.x: I had a wonderful conversation with him a couple of months ago, and I phoned him before this interview and I said, “Why did you pick Ed for that album you did about the wasp?”
